name: Grey alien visitor
about: A small, big-headed visitor with a gentle voice shifted just off true.

name: Insectoid alien
about: A clicking, buzzing bug-like alien whose mandibles flutter through every word.

name: Gas giant alien
about: A vast floating creature from a gas giant, slow and deep as rolling storm clouds.

name: Crystal being
about: A being made of living crystal, its words ringing out like struck glass.

name: Chirpy little martian
about: A squeaky little red-planet visitor whose words chirp and squeal at the ends.

name: Tentacled oracle
about: A many-armed sea creature from another world, gurgling wisdom from deep water.

name: Alien diplomat
about: A calm, polished envoy with a shadow voice an octave below and a slightly wrong shape.

name: Frog-like telepath
about: An amphibian mind-reader whose watery throat pulses slowly as it speaks.

name: Alien hive queen
about: A towering hive ruler speaking in buzzing layers while her brood echoes every word.

name: Galactic council
about: A ring of very different alien ambassadors all speaking your words at once.

name: Slime creature
about: A dripping blob of living goo burbling its words through bubbles of slime.

name: Two-headed alien
about: Two heads on one body, a high voice in one ear and a low one in the other.

name: Choir of tiny microbes
about: Thousands of microscopic beings squeaking your words together in a tiny, loose chorus.

name: Whistling alien
about: A visitor who talks in pure whistles, every vowel turned into a thin sliding tone.

name: Starship computer
about: A calm, crisp ship's computer voice speaking over the hum of the bridge.

name: Space station announcement
about: A chime and an echoing announcement ringing through the corridors of an orbital station.

name: Captain on the bridge
about: A commanding captain's voice on a busy starship bridge, consoles chirping all round.

name: Red alert on the bridge
about: An urgent officer on the ship's intercom while the alarm whoops across the bridge.

name: Ship's engineer below decks
about: An engineer shouting up from the roaring engine core over a crackling radio.

name: Mothership over the city
about: A colossal ship hovering over the city, its voice booming down from the sky.

name: Airlock warning voice
about: A cold warning voice inside a steel airlock just before the outer door opens.

name: Cargo bay intercom
about: A buzzing loudspeaker voice echoing round a vast empty cargo bay.

name: Escape pod radio
about: A frightened voice from a tiny escape pod drifting further from the ship.

name: Cryosleep wake-up
about: A frozen sleeper thawing out: slow, low and groggy at first, then catching up to normal.

name: Docking bay control
about: A clipped digital voice guiding ships into dock over the rumble of distant thrusters.

name: Astronaut helmet
about: Your voice inside a sealed space suit helmet, close and boxy.

name: Mission control
about: Ground control talking to the crew in orbit, with a beep tone at the start and end.

name: Talking from the moon
about: An astronaut speaking from the dusty surface of the moon, beeps and hiss and all.

name: Spacewalk on a tether
about: An astronaut slowly drifting round your head on a tether outside the station.

name: Last message from orbit
about: A fragile transmission from a failing capsule, breaking up into silence.

name: Deep space probe report
about: A lonely robot probe beaming its report home from beyond the outer planets.

name: Red planet rover
about: A little six-wheeled robot reporting back from a dusty red desert.

name: Launch countdown
about: A launch director calling the final countdown as the rocket roars to life.

name: Moon bounce echo
about: Every word comes back a moment later, bounced off the moon and home again.

name: Running out of air
about: A breathless astronaut whispering inside a helmet, heart pounding as the air runs low.

name: Glitching hologram
about: A flickering projected message that skips, stutters and shimmers like a damaged hologram.

name: Teleporter fade-out
about: Your voice dissolving into sparkling particles as the teleporter takes you away.

name: Beaming in
about: A rising shimmer and a backwards swell as you take shape right in front of them.

name: Hologram museum guide
about: A thin, clean, slightly metallic guide voice floating in the air of a big museum hall.

name: Flickering recorded message
about: A worn holographic recording that flickers in and out with bursts of tape noise.

name: Teleporter scramble
about: A teleport gone wrong, your syllables arriving out of order in a spiral of metal.

name: Out of phase with reality
about: Half here and half somewhere else, your voice beating slowly against itself.

name: Three hologram copies
about: Three slightly out-of-step hologram copies of you speaking side by side.

name: Inside a transport beam
about: Your words humming and shimmering inside a column of transport energy.

name: Interpreter at the portal
about: Two voices at once, one an octave down and one shifted up, translating through a glowing gate.

name: Warp speed
about: A voice rising and whooshing past as the ship jumps to warp speed.

name: Through a wormhole
about: Your words spiral round and round as they tumble through a tunnel in space.

name: Falling into a black hole
about: Your voice stretching longer and lower as gravity drags it past the point of no return.

name: Caught in a time loop
about: Every phrase echoes back again and again, swirling, caught in a loop of time.

name: Time traveller's warning
about: An urgent message from the future, warping and slipping as it crosses the years.

name: Jump to hyperspace
about: Every sentence launches with a revving whoosh like the ship leaping into hyperspace.

name: You from a parallel universe
about: You and another you from the next universe over, a little out of tune and out of step.

name: Time running backwards
about: A traveller caught where time flows the wrong way, every word playing backwards.

name: Time frozen still
about: Moments of your voice hang frozen in the air while the rest of time stands still.

name: Near the speed of light
about: Your voice dragged slow and low near the speed of light, then snapping back to normal.

name: Visitor from another dimension
about: A voice smeared and swirling as it leaks through a crack between dimensions.

name: Signal from deep space
about: A faint voice reaching us after centuries, thinned and smeared by the noise between stars.

name: First-contact translator
about: An alien speaks and a machine translator speaks over it, both at once.

name: Pulsar beacon
about: Your words pulsing on and off like the beat of a spinning star.

name: Alien radio broadcast
about: A broadcast from another world, turned inside out and drifting off the station.

name: Numbers from the void
about: A flat, mysterious voice reading numbers on a lonely frequency from beyond the moon.

name: Cosmic static whisper
about: A breathy whisper carried on the hiss and crackle of the cosmos.

name: Satellite downlink
about: A crunchy digital voice beamed down from a satellite, chirping as the link locks.

name: Encrypted alien code
about: Scrambled, inverted and chopped: a message coded so no human ear can crack it.

name: Caught by a radio telescope
about: A smeared, wavering voice pulled out of the sky by a giant dish, an eerie whine beneath it.

name: Machine of an unknown language
about: A machine rebuilding your syllables into a high buzzing language nobody on Earth has heard.

name: Android science officer
about: A precise, unhurried artificial officer reporting from the science station on the bridge.

name: Clone army
about: Rows of identical helmeted soldiers saying every word in perfect, chilling unison.

name: Clone twins
about: Two perfect copies of you, one in each ear, a hair apart in pitch.

name: Mind-linked collective
about: A group mind of many linked voices speaking as one from all around you.

name: Bounty hunter's helmet
about: A gruff hunter speaking through the speaker grille of a battered armored helmet.

name: Ship's medical android
about: A soothing synthetic doctor in the ship's medical bay, monitors bleeping nearby.

name: Engineered super soldier
about: A lab-grown warrior with an unnaturally deep, powerful voice.

name: Voice from the cloning tank
about: A half-grown clone speaking from inside a bubbling glass tank of fluid.

name: Machine oracle in the temple
about: A thinking machine answering in a sung open chord that rings round a stone temple.

name: Starfighter pilot in a dogfight
about: A pilot shouting over the radio while swinging hard from side to side.

name: Battle cruiser commander
about: A deep, steady commander's voice filling a giant flagship as the battle begins.

name: Shields failing
about: A damaged ship's intercom breaking up and stuttering as the shields flicker and fail.

name: Ion storm interference
about: A crackling transmission mangled by the charged clouds of an ion storm.

name: Asteroid miner on the radio
about: A rough-voiced miner calling in from a rock tumbling through the asteroid belt.

name: Space pirate radio
about: A rowdy outlaw broadcasting on a stolen channel through a crackling overdriven mic.

name: Boarding party in the corridor
about: Armored boarders storming toward you down a metal corridor, radios crackling.

name: Alien warlord
about: A brutal alien commander roaring orders to an arena full of cheering troops.

name: Orders from a distant battle
about: A commander yelling over a crackling field radio while explosions boom far away.

name: Laser gunner on the comm
about: A gunner shouting through a zapping, sweeping comm line as the cannons fire.

name: Desert planet trader
about: A dusty trader haggling in a scorching wind on a desert world with two suns.

name: Ice planet outpost
about: A shivering voice on a frozen world, words glinting like ice in a howling blizzard.

name: Jungle moon explorer
about: An explorer radioing the ship from a steaming alien jungle full of strange calls.

name: Ocean world diver
about: A diver in a helmet speaking from the floor of an endless alien ocean.

name: Volcanic world
about: A voice shouting across rivers of lava on a planet that never stops burning.

name: Storm on an alien moon
about: A weak radio call from a far moon where thunder never stops rolling.

name: Crystal caves of a far moon
about: Words chiming off giant crystals deep in a dripping cave on a distant moon.

name: Abandoned moon base
about: A lone survivor's radio voice echoing through an empty base on a dead grey moon.

name: Singer in a glowing ocean
about: A shining sea creature singing your words in key, every note leaving a twinkling trail.

name: Voice of a burning star
about: A living star speaking in roaring flame from one end of the sky to the other.

name: Ancient cosmic entity
about: Something older than the galaxy, speaking in layered octaves across endless space.

name: Nebula spirit
about: A drifting cloud of glowing gas that breathes your words in sparkling whispers.

name: Dark matter whisper
about: An unseen presence whispering from the dark between galaxies, words trailing backwards.

name: Mind the size of a galaxy
about: A boundless intelligence humming your words on a vast choir chord that fills the universe.

name: Echo from the edge of space
about: Your voice calling out to the edge of the universe and echoing back changed.

name: Being of pure energy
about: A crackling, humming creature of pure light, buzzing with energy as it speaks.

name: Glowing radioactive being
about: A creature fizzing with radiation, its voice crackling and spitting like a hot wire.

name: Guardian of the portal
about: A deep, ancient gatekeeper whose words shimmer downward through a vast stone hall.

name: Swarm mind of fragments
about: A thinking cloud of a million tiny pieces, each one carrying a scrap of your words.
